criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First line is 208 chars, inside the ~210 see-more cutoff, and names the trigger (3 August FERC comment window), the asset, the 38 percent magnitude and the closing date. Short of 10 because the mechanism is only gestured at as 'an amendment'; the non-capacity track and delegated authority arrive in paragraph two.

criteria.name: Mechanism load-bearing + AK consequence
criteria.notes: Mechanism genuinely gates Alaska capital and procurement decisions. Consequence carries sector, decision, named actors and timeframe. Scored before the post-scoring edit that restored the dossier's explicit AI-compute framing and the not-near-term-capacity caveat, which were the scorer's own named lift for this criterion.

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.notes: All five body layers appear in stack_anatomy.json layers[] with matching controlling actors. No invented layers. The dropped CWA Section 401 layer is correctly absent with no seam left in the chain.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.notes: Names one layer, the actor (the Director or the Director's designee) and the binary, matching the dossier exactly. 'The switch is a clock, not a vote' delivers the asymmetry and distinguishes it from the six-member PMC. Declining to name an incumbent Director is correct given ferc.gov returned 403.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: A real, grounded, proportionate position on why leverage sits in a deadline rather than a hearing, on-key with post_001. Scored before the edit that restored the near-term-capacity caveat.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Concrete trigger (decide this week, hard stop 28 August), clean positioned / not-positioned split, and a named second date. 'This fall' is the softest element and the dossier offers nothing firmer.

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.notes: Every dossier layer traces to a primary document and the chokepoint citation is primary (18 CFR 375.308 read against the Federal Register docket), both fetched twice with verbatim confirmation. Deducted because 'Alaska's largest hydro plant' and 'the largest identified block of new firm non-gas Railbelt energy' trace only to the mapper's analytical prose, not to a fetched source. Cornell LII is a mirror, forced by the ecfr.gov block.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, position-taking, Alaska-first, specific, no banned phrases, curly quotes, closes on a question. One drift against the accessibility plank: 'non-capacity', 'intervenors' and 'Part I' go unglossed.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Inside both windows with a single well-placed bullet block, but the chokepoint paragraph runs 5 sentences and the nameplate-arithmetic paragraph runs 7. Bullet block is at the 5-item ceiling and items are not uniformly single-clause.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Genuinely debatable, two real horns, tied directly to the chokepoint's binary rather than to the topic generally. No CTA, no rhetorical softener.
